cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Well Operations Geologist to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Key Accountabilities:
Well Planning
HSSE focus and ability to influence compliance standards for Safety and Operational Risks
Support well planning activities and construction of relevant NWS documents consistent with [Company name masked]'s Wells Common Process, WCD-SOR, D1-D5 Stage gates
Assist in the creation of pre-drill risk registers and ensure mitigation and contingency plans are created for all geological risks.
Ensure integration of well planning and operational activity through strong collaboration with key customers, NWD and Wells leadership
Lead the construction of the GOP ensuring all relevant information is contained in this document.
Geological Operations
Lead the NWS efforts in late design (D5-11) activities consistent with [Company name masked] well planning process, leading the creation of the GOP prior to drilling, and the EOWR and required handover documents following TD.
Lead the daily NWD/subsurface operations meeting with the Rig based subsurface entities (WSG, Bio Strat, ML, LWD), present NDS, expected geology in subsurface hole section previews, and reviews.
Participate in LWOP, CWOP exercises, ensure that the specialty vendors are engaged early in the process, present material on NDS, expected geology for subsurface hole section previews, hole section reviews for the well.
Provide support to the wellsite geologist: daily and as needed ops call, provide up to date information and offset date, collaborate between Subsurface and Wells to ensure all well objectives are delivered safely.
Ensure efficient delivery of the data acquisition program, ensure Vendors Co-owners are delivering and receiving all required data and updates. SPA for Co-Owner communication and information dissemination.
Post Well
Support successful EOW Report completion ensuring the report meets the expectations of the New Wells Common Process
Ensure all data is finalized and electronically captures in the corporate regional data store and hard data copy is distributed accordingly to partners.
Capture and document all post well key takeaways in PWR and share in appropriate NWD venues.
Support root cause analysis for any NPT event related to subsurface operations (Orange category) and ensure these findings are distributed through the appropriate venues and partners.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
5 Years of relevant industry experience, most of which should have been gained in a geological operation environment
Geological, seismic and petrophysical log interpretation and workstation skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Master's Degree in Geology or related field
Collaborative team-first mentality, self-motivated, with a strong ability to integrate across fields
Preferred Requirements
Proven experience in well planning and operations geology, well-site geology. Working knowledge of drilling operations, pore pressure, mudlogging is desirable.
Petrel or landmark interpretative software experience
Experience with deep water [Location masked] exploration and development wells

cond_0219.intro: We are looking for a Well Operations Geologist to join our team.
cond_0219.responsibilities:
Key Accountabilities:
Well Planning
HSSE focus and ability to influence compliance standards for Safety and Operational Risks
Support well planning activities and construction of relevant NWS documents consistent with [Company name masked]'s Wells Common Process, WCD-SOR, D1-D5 Stage gates
Assist in the creation of pre-drill risk registers and ensure mitigation and contingency plans are created for all geological risks.
Ensure integration of well planning and operational activity through strong collaboration with key customers, NWD and Wells leadership
Lead the construction of the GOP ensuring all relevant information is contained in this document.
Geological Operations
Lead the NWS efforts in late design (D5-11) activities consistent with [Company name masked] well planning process, leading the creation of the GOP prior to drilling, and the EOWR and required handover documents following TD.
Lead the daily NWD/subsurface operations meeting with the Rig based subsurface entities (WSG, Bio Strat, ML, LWD), present NDS, expected geology in subsurface hole section previews, and reviews.
Participate in LWOP, CWOP exercises, ensure that the specialty vendors are engaged early in the process, present material on NDS, expected geology for subsurface hole section previews, hole section reviews for the well.
Provide support to the wellsite geologist: daily and as needed ops call, provide up to date information and offset date, collaborate between Subsurface and Wells to ensure all well objectives are delivered safely.
Ensure efficient delivery of the data acquisition program, ensure Vendors Co-owners are delivering and receiving all required data and updates. SPA for Co-Owner communication and information dissemination.
Post Well
Support successful EOW Report completion ensuring the report meets the expectations of the New Wells Common Process
Ensure all data is finalized and electronically captures in the corporate regional data store and hard data copy is distributed accordingly to partners.
Capture and document all post well key takeaways in PWR and share in appropriate NWD venues.
Support root cause analysis for any NPT event related to subsurface operations (Orange category) and ensure these findings are distributed through the appropriate venues and partners.

cond_0329.intro: Responsible for supporting the provision of subsurface assurance and guidance for the development and production of reservoirs, using sound technical knowledge to ensure robust subsurface description and clear articulation of the surface uncertainties and risks of the field to underpin project advancement. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with geological operations and well planning work.
cond_0329.responsibilities:
Key Accountabilities:
Well Planning
HSSE focus and ability to influence compliance standards for Safety and Operational Risks
Support well planning activities and construction of relevant NWS documents consistent with [Company name masked]'s Wells Common Process, WCD-SOR, D1-D5 Stage gates
Assist in the creation of pre-drill risk registers and ensure mitigation and contingency plans are created for all geological risks.
Ensure integration of well planning and operational activity through strong collaboration with key customers, NWD and Wells leadership
Lead the construction of the GOP ensuring all relevant information is contained in this document.
Geological Operations
Lead the NWS efforts in late design (D5-11) activities consistent with [Company name masked] well planning process, leading the creation of the GOP prior to drilling, and the EOWR and required handover documents following TD.
Lead the daily NWD/subsurface operations meeting with the Rig based subsurface entities (WSG, Bio Strat, ML, LWD), present NDS, expected geology in subsurface hole section previews, and reviews.
Participate in LWOP, CWOP exercises, ensure that the specialty vendors are engaged early in the process, present material on NDS, expected geology for subsurface hole section previews, hole section reviews for the well.
Provide support to the wellsite geologist: daily and as needed ops call, provide up to date information and offset date, collaborate between Subsurface and Wells to ensure all well objectives are delivered safely.
Ensure efficient delivery of the data acquisition program, ensure Vendors Co-owners are delivering and receiving all required data and updates. SPA for Co-Owner communication and information dissemination.
Post Well
Support successful EOW Report completion ensuring the report meets the expectations of the New Wells Common Process
Ensure all data is finalized and electronically captures in the corporate regional data store and hard data copy is distributed accordingly to partners.
Capture and document all post well key takeaways in PWR and share in appropriate NWD venues.
Support root cause analysis for any NPT event related to subsurface operations (Orange category) and ensure these findings are distributed through the appropriate venues and partners.
cond_0329.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
5 Years of relevant industry experience, most of which should have been gained in a geological operation environment
Proven experience in well planning and operations geology, well-site geology
Geological, seismic and petrophysical log interpretation and workstation skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Master's Degree in Geology or related field
Preferred Requirements
Working knowledge of drilling operations, pore pressure, mudlogging
Collaborative team-first mentality, self-motivated, with a strong ability to integrate across fields
Petrel or landmark interpretative software experience
Experience with deep water [Location masked] exploration and development wells

This role supports the provision of subsurface assurance and guidance for the development and production of reservoirs, using sound technical knowledge to help ensure robust subsurface description and clear articulation of the surface uncertainties and risks of the field to underpin project advancement.
cond_0405.responsibilities:
Key Accountabilities:
Well Planning
Maintain HSSE focus and help influence compliance standards for Safety and Operational Risks
Coordinate on well planning activities and construction of relevant NWS documents consistent with [Company name masked]'s Wells Common Process, WCD-SOR, D1-D5 Stage gates
Assist in the creation of pre-drill risk registers and work with the team to ensure mitigation and contingency plans are created for all geological risks
Help ensure integration of well planning and operational activity through strong collaboration with key customers, NWD and Wells leadership
Coordinate with cross-functional partners to construct the GOP, ensuring all relevant information is contained in this document
Geological Operations
Coordinate NWS efforts in late design (D5-11) activities consistent with [Company name masked] well planning process, working with the team on the creation of the GOP prior to drilling, and the EOWR and required handover documents following TD
Facilitate the daily NWD/subsurface operations meeting with the Rig based subsurface entities (WSG, Bio Strat, ML, LWD), share NDS, expected geology in subsurface hole section previews, and reviews
Participate in LWOP, CWOP exercises, help ensure that the specialty vendors are engaged early in the process, present material on NDS, expected geology for subsurface hole section previews, hole section reviews for the well
Support the wellsite geologist through daily and as-needed ops calls, share up to date information and offset data, and help coordinate between Subsurface and Wells to ensure all well objectives are delivered safely
Help ensure efficient delivery of the data acquisition program, working with Vendors and Co-owners to ensure all required data and updates are delivered and received. SPA for Co-Owner communication and information dissemination
Post Well
Support successful EOW Report completion, working with the team to ensure the report meets the expectations of the New Wells Common Process
Help ensure all data is finalized and electronically captured in the corporate regional data store and that hard data copy is distributed accordingly to partners
Capture and document all post well key takeaways in PWR and share in appropriate NWD venues
Support root cause analysis for any NPT event related to subsurface operations (Orange category) and help ensure these findings are distributed through the appropriate venues and partners
cond_0405.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
5 Years of relevant industry experience, most of which should have been gained in a geological operation environment
Geological, seismic and petrophysical log interpretation and workstation skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Master's Degree in Geology or related field
Collaborative team-first mentality, self-motivated, with a strong ability to integrate across fields
Preferred Requirements
Proven experience in well planning and operations geology, well-site geology. Working knowledge of drilling operations, pore pressure, mudlogging is desirable
Petrel or landmark interpretative software experience
Experience with deep water [Location masked] exploration and development wells
cond_0405.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0405.values: We value ambition, achievement, and consistent follow-through. We believe strong outcomes come from maintaining high expectations for the work we do.

cond_0611.intro: We are looking for a Well Operations Geologist to join our team. You will take ownership of subsurface assurance and guidance for the development and production of reservoirs, applying sound technical knowledge to deliver robust subsurface description and clear articulation of subsurface uncertainties and risks to underpin project advancement.
cond_0611.responsibilities:
Well Planning
Maintain HSSE focus and drive compliance with Safety and Operational Risk standards
Lead well planning activities and construction of relevant NWS documents consistent with [Company name masked]'s Wells Common Process, WCD-SOR, D1-D5 Stage gates
Direct the creation of pre-drill risk registers and ensure mitigation and contingency plans are in place for all geological risks
Ensure integration of well planning and operational activity through strong collaboration with key customers, NWD and Wells leadership
Lead the construction of the GOP ensuring all relevant information is contained in this document
Geological Operations
Lead NWS efforts in late design (D5-11) activities consistent with [Company name masked] well planning process, directing the creation of the GOP prior to drilling, and the EOWR and required handover documents following TD
Chair the daily NWD/subsurface operations meeting with the Rig based subsurface entities (WSG, Bio Strat, ML, LWD), presenting NDS, expected geology in subsurface hole section previews, and reviews
Drive LWOP, CWOP exercises, ensuring specialty vendors are engaged early in the process; present material on NDS and expected geology for subsurface hole section previews and hole section reviews
Deliver direct support to the wellsite geologist: daily and as-needed ops calls, providing up-to-date information and offset data, and leading coordination between Subsurface and Wells to ensure all well objectives are delivered safely
Own efficient delivery of the data acquisition program, ensuring Vendors and Co-owners are delivering and receiving all required data and updates; serve as SPA for Co-Owner communication and information dissemination
Post Well
Drive successful EOW Report completion ensuring the report meets the expectations of the New Wells Common Process
Ensure all data is finalized and electronically captured in the corporate regional data store, with hard data copies distributed accordingly to partners
Capture and document all post-well key takeaways in PWR and present findings in appropriate NWD venues
Lead root cause analysis for any NPT event related to subsurface operations (Orange category) and ensure findings are distributed through the appropriate venues and partners
